sourceTitle: Portfolio AI：一个自我迭代的AI Native 工作系统

units.role: establish the product and the central design problem
distinguish delivered outcomes from pilots before explaining the process
use an actual failure to establish why the workflow needed redesign
define AI Native through observable behavior rather than tool branding
introduce the two-part narrative through the operating environment
show one shared work environment and where the three kinds of work meet
make the external memory model concrete and disclose its maintenance limits
explain where rules come from, where they belong, and how they are maintained
distinguish prompts, reusable procedures and actual automation
demonstrate the environment using this case study as a concrete content task
explain isolation without claiming technical sandboxing that does not exist
briefly explain incremental maintenance without making release mechanics the main story
preserve a concrete information-model decision as supporting evidence
use a Design-workspace delegation to test project continuity and reveal the remaining quality gap
introduce the second half through generation quality and repeatability
retain the real prompt-generated baseline
show the designer directing a skill-assisted critique
show concrete improvement rather than claiming that a skill redesigned the product
retain interaction-craft evidence without interrupting the main argument
make the design-system failure the turning point toward repeatable quality
show reference selection and tool boundaries without outsourcing taste
document the accepted working architecture without imposing an unused ideal hierarchy
demonstrate how real composition exposes defects invisible in token inventories
state the dated release evidence and keep historical versions distinct
translate the work into specific AI-product design contributions without claiming unearned business results
close the problem-solving arc with progress and limits
guide later pitch and website selection without creating a second factual narrative
retain the operational handoff contract and technical discovery outside the main narrative
retain existing approved media and correct historical versus current labels
separate project evidence from method references and unverified general claims
preserve unresolved evidence and the approval gate before website edits
owner-approved positioning, workflow, infrastructure and local mapping scope
verbatim owner-reviewed Chinese copy and faithful English translation
